latest_release.name: Astron Agent v2.0.0
latest_release.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> 从 1.x 升级前，请先备份原有的 **Agent（智能体）、工作流和业务数据**。旧账号保留原 UID 和资源归属，首次登录 2.0 需要管理员发放一次性链接来设置新密码。

## 升级前备份

1. 在旧控制台导出关键工作流的 DSL（YAML），记录关键 Agent 的提示词、模型配置及工具、知识库和 Skill 绑定。工作流的发布版本、Agent 定义、历史记录和空间权限应随业务库一起备份。
2. 在维护窗口内停止旧服务写入，备份 MySQL、PostgreSQL、MinIO 对象和持久卷，并妥善保存原部署配置、签名密钥及服务凭据。建议先在隔离环境恢复备份，验证能正常读取关键 Agent 和工作流。
3. 升级时沿用原数据库、对象存储、数据卷和凭据。Compose 部署应沿用原项目名和挂载配置，使用 `v2.0.0` 源码对应的部署文件，并设置 `ASTRON_AGENT_VERSION=v2.0.0` 固定应用镜像版本。Helm 可使用 `global.astronAgentVersion: v2.0.0` 固定镜像版本，并保留现有 PVC 和 Secret。升级过程应避开 `docker compose down -v` 和旧版 Flyway 初始化脚本。

[Docker Compose 部署指南](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/blob/v2.0.0/docs/zh/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md) · [Helm 部署指南](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/blob/v2.0.0/helm/README.md)

## 旧账号如何继续登录

2.0 改用控制台内置的用户名和密码登录。默认部署启动时执行数据库迁移，并从原 Console 业务库导入旧账号。旧用户需在原账号上设置新密码。2.0 登录使用内置账号系统的密码。

1. 等待旧账号导入完成。若旧用户名重复或不合法，管理员可按原 UID 配置登录名映射，再执行导入。 [账号导入与映射说明](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/blob/v2.0.0/console/backend/README.md#已有用户启用)
2. 管理员核实账号归属后，在 `docker/astronAgent` 目录执行以下命令。若存在重名，用 `--uid '原用户UID'` 指定账号。

   ```bash
   docker compose exec console-hub python manage.py issue_password_reset --username '原用户名'
   ```

3. 将命令输出的登录名和重设链接私下交给本人。若输出的是 `/reset-password#…` 相对路径，将其拼到控制台地址后，也可通过 `--origin` 让命令直接生成完整链接。链接 **1 小时内有效**，成功设置密码后即失效。用户随后在 `/login` 使用输出的用户名和新密码登录。

新用户可在 `/register` 注册。已有用户请通过重设密码继续使用原账号，以便访问原有空间和资源。

## 本版主要更新

- **Python 控制台与租户服务**。Console 后端迁移至 Django，Tenant 服务迁移至 FastAPI。内置账号接管登录，沿用原空间与资源权限、应用 ID 及仍有效的 API 密钥。 [#1837](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/pull/1837)
- **统一 Agent 执行内核**。独立 Agent 的对话、调试和工作流 Agent 节点统一使用 Deep Agents。工作流可引用独立 Agent，新运行使用最新已发布版本，同一次运行的重试和恢复继续使用启动时选定的版本。普通模型推理支持 OpenAI 兼容、Anthropic 和 Google 协议。 [#1733](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/pull/1733) · [#1739](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/pull/1739) · [#1837](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/pull/1837)
- **工具、MCP 与原生 Skill**。统一 HTTP 工具和 MCP 连接的接入、调试与版本引用。Agent 可使用授权的 Skill 及附件，配置 E2B 后可在沙箱运行 Skill 脚本。 [Agent 运行与模型兼容说明](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/blob/v2.0.0/core/agent/README.md)
- **编排与发布体验**。更新 Agent 配置与调试工作区、工作流画布及资源目录，支持按分类筛选和收藏。Agent 和工作流可保存不可变版本、发布到市场或发布为 API，并可在控制台查看 API 调用示例。 [#1837](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/pull/1837) · [API 集成指南](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/blob/v2.0.0/docs/zh/guide/integration.md)
- **部署更新**。Docker Compose 和 Helm 已适配 Python Console 与 Tenant，新部署可直接启动内置账号系统。 [#1837](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/pull/1837)

## 升级后检查

- 使用迁移后的账号确认个人和团队空间、原有 Agent、工作流及资源归属，并试运行关键流程。Agent 使用的模型需支持原生工具调用。若旧工作流使用星火 WebSocket 模型，需改用受支持的 HTTP(S) 协议并重新调试。
- 验证已发布的市场条目、API 和现有应用密钥。若使用 Compose，可执行 `docker compose exec console-hub python manage.py adopt_legacy_publications`，核对旧发布记录是否全部迁移。若命令报告待处理记录，请在发布管理中核对并解决后重新检查。

[查看 v1.1.2 至 v2.0.0 的完整变更](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/compare/v1.1.2...v2.0.0)

[![Astron Agent Logo](./logo.svg)](https://iflytek.github.io/astron-agent/) [![Astron_Readme](./docs/imgs/Astron_Readme.png)](https://agent.xfyun.cn)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-apache2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/iflytek/astron-agent?style=social)](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/stargazers) [![Ask DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/badge.svg)](https://deepwiki.com/iflytek/astron-agent) English | [简体中文](docs/zh/README.md) | [日本語](docs/ja/README.md)
## 🔭 What is Astron Agent Astron Agent is an **enterprise-grade, commercial-friendly** Agentic Workflow development platform that integrates AI workflow orchestration, model management, AI and MCP tool integration, RPA automation, and team collaboration features. The platform supports **high-availability** deployment, enabling organizations to rapidly build **scalable, production-ready** intelligent agent applications and establish their AI foundation for the future. ### Why Choose Astron Agent? - **Stable and Reliable**: Built on the same core technology as the iFLYTEK Astron Agent Platform, providing enterprise-grade reliability with a fully available high-availability version open source. - **Cross-System Integration**: Natively integrates intelligent RPA, efficiently connecting internal and external enterprise systems, enabling seamless interaction between Agents and enterprise systems. - **Enterprise-Grade Open Ecosystem**: Deeply compatible with various industry models and tools, supporting custom extensions and flexibly adapting to diverse enterprise scenarios. - **Business-Friendly**: Released under the Apache 2.0 License, with no commercial restrictions, allowing free commercial use. ### Key Features - **Enterprise-Grade High Availability:** Full-stack capabilities for development, building, optimization, and management. Supports one-click deployment with strong reliability. - **Intelligent RPA Integration:** Enables cross-system process automation, empowering Agents with controllable execution to achieve a complete loop “from decision to action.” - **Ready-to-Use Tool Ecosystem:** Integrates massive AI capabilities and tools from the [iFLYTEK Open Platform](https://www.xfyun.cn), validated by millions of developers, supporting plug-and-play integration without extra development. - **Flexible Large Model Support:** Offers diverse access methods, from rapid API-based model access and validation to one-click deployment of enterprise-level MaaS (Model as a Service) on-premises clusters, meeting needs of all scales. ## 🤝 [Adopters](https://iflytek.github.io/astron-agent/cases/)
                   

                 
## 📰 News ### 🔄 Ongoing ### 📅 Past - **[Astron Hackathon @ 2025 iFLYTEK Global 1024 Developer Festival](https://luma.com/9zmbc6xb)** 🎤 @mklong - **[Astron Agent Zhengzhou Meetup](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/discussions/672)** 🎤 @lyj715824 @wowo-zZ - **[Astron on Campus @ Zhejiang University of Finance and Economics](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/oim_Z0ckgpFwf5jOskoJuA)** 🎤 @lyj715824 - **[Astron Agent & RPA · Qingdao Meetup Brings Agentic AI!](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent/discussions/740)** 🎤 @vsxd @doctorbruce @MaxwellJean - **[Astron Training Camp · Cohort #1](https://www.aidaxue.com/astronCamp)** 🎤 @lyj715824 @Thomas1024-Astron @abelzha - **[Astron Talk @ Chongqing Mini Tech Fest](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/HROf1zZpkPVDSsCQrv2jRg)** 🎤 @lyj715824 - **[Astron Agent @ MWC Barcelona 2026](https://www.iflytek.com/en/news-events/mwc2026.html)** - **[Astron Agent & RPA · Hefei Meetup](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/tDJaoOLUrjBlgMLDurvHCw)** 🎤 @lyj715824 @doctorbruce - **[Astron Industrial Intelligence Hackathon](https://awesome-astron-workflow.dev/activities/astron-industrial-intelligence-hackathon)** 🎤 @lyj715824 @horizon220222 ## 🚀 Quick Start We offer two deployment methods to meet different scenarios: ### Option 1: Docker Compose (Recommended for Quick Start) > After startup, open the console and select **Register** to create an account, then sign in. ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent.git # Navigate to the Docker deployment directory cd astron-agent/docker/astronAgent docker compose up -d --build ``` No `.env` file needs to be copied or edited, and no environment variables need to be set. Open `http://localhost/` locally, or `http:///` from another machine; the default port is 80. Register an account and sign in. Optional domain, HTTPS, and external-service settings are described in the [deployment guide](docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md). #### 📊 Service Access Addresses After startup, you can access the services at the following addresses: **AstronAgent** - **Application Frontend (nginx proxy)**: http://localhost/ ### Option 2: Helm (For Kubernetes Environments) > 🚧 **Note**: Helm charts are currently under development. Stay tuned for updates! ```bash # Coming soon # helm repo add astron-agent https://iflytek.github.io/astron-agent # helm install astron-agent astron-agent/astron-agent ``` --- > 📖 For complete deployment instructions and configuration details, see [Deployment Guide](docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md) ## 📖 Using Astron Cloud **Try Astron**：Astron Cloud provides a ready-to-use environment for creating and managing Agents. Get quick access at [https://agent.xfyun.cn](https://agent.xfyun.cn). **Using Guide**：For detailed usage instructions, please refer to [Quick Start Guide](https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/Agent03-%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97.html). ## 📚 Documentation - [🔌 Integration Guide](docs/guide/integration.md) — call published workflows from an existing project via HTTP/SSE - [🚀 Deployment Guide](docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md) - [🔧 Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) - [🚀 Quick Start](https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/Agent02-%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E5%BC%80%E5%A7%8B.html) - [📘 Development Guide](https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/Agent03-%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97.html#_1-%E6%8C%87%E4%BB%A4%E5%9E%8B%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E4%BD%93%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91) - [📖 Tutorial](https://scn5s6198j3j.feishu.cn/wiki/VefnwvPbridJBikCUb1cYXO9nYb) - [💡 Best Practices](https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/AgentNew-%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E5%AE%9E%E8%B7%B5%E6%A1%88%E4%BE%8B.html) - [📱 Use Cases](https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/Agent05-%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%E6%A1%88%E4%BE%8B.html) - [❓ FAQ](https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/Agent06-FAQ.html) - [🌐 Open Source Workflows](https://awesome-astron-workflow.dev/#workflows) ## 🤝 Contributing We welcome contributions of all kinds!
